name: Jambolan (Jamun)
description: Jambolan is an elite tropical berry renowned for its anti-diabetic properties and cardiovascular protection. Its phytochemical matrix, rich in anthocyanins, jamboline glycosides, and ellagic acid, stabilizes carbohydrate metabolism, protects vascular endothelia, and neutralizes systemic oxidative stress.
macroIntro: A hydration-rich framework dominated by slow-release sugars and organic acids with negligible lipid/protein baselines.
microIntro: A dense, bioavailable phytochemical matrix yielding essential antioxidants, Vitamin C, and metabolic glycosides.

healthBenefits: Starch Moderation: Jamboline glycosides impede the breakdown of starches into glucose.
Vascular Shielding: Anthocyanins neutralize free radicals and prevent LDL oxidation.
GI Tone: Natural tannins provide an astringent effect on intestinal mucosa.
Pancreatic Support: Extracts optimize insulin secretion and reduce hepatic glucose output.
Oral Hygiene: Polyphenols inhibit plaque-forming bacteria in the oral biome.
precautionsIntro: Considerations regarding hypoglycemia, tannins, and food synergy:
precautions: Hypoglycemic Risk: Potent glucose-lowering effects may synergize with diabetes medication; monitor blood sugar levels.
Tannin Irritation: High tannin volume can cause gastric distress on an empty stomach.
Dairy Contraindication: Consumption of milk post-jambolan may cause protein coagulation and severe digestive discomfort.
